headline: 5 Stocks to Grab as Manufacturing Activity Hits Four-Year High
summary: AIT, DOV, HUBB, RBC and TRMB stand out as manufacturing activity hits a four-year high amid seven months of sector growth.

headline: Trimble Second Quarter Earnings Call and Webcast
summary: Trimble (Nasdaq: TRMB) will hold a conference call on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 8 a.m. ET to review its second quarter 2026 results. The call will be broadcast live on the web at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/848449078. Analysts who wish to dial into the call may do so by first registering at https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/848449078?pwd=RQy4WSHT. Upon registration, dial-in details will be sent via email to the registrant.
